MacinRender nlohmann-compatible JSON (mradm-json)

The double formatting (src/dtoa.rs) is translated to Rust from nlohmann/json v3.12.0
(single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp: detail::dtoa_impl and detail::to_chars), which implements
Grisu2 after Florian Loitsch, "Printing Floating-Point Numbers Quickly and Accurately with
Integers", PLDI 2010. https://github.com/nlohmann/json — nlohmann/json is licensed under the MIT
license (see LICENSE), Copyright (c) 2013-2025 Niels Lohmann. Upstream source fingerprints are
recorded in PROVENANCE.json.

The parser, the serializer layout and the error texts are written for this project to reproduce
the observable behaviour of nlohmann/json 3.12.0 as the project used it (default parse options,
dump() / dump(indent) with ensure_ascii off). Syntax-error descriptions are the project's own.
